name: Principality of Theodoro
alt: Lordship of Theodoro and the Maritime Region

successors.name: Ottoman Empire
successors.text: Mangup and the principality, which surrendered to the Ottomans at the end of December 1475

ledger.x: 1333: the Principality of Gothia/Theodoro in the Crimean mountains (a bridging date).
1423: Prince Alexios holds a coastal strip taken from the Genoese province of Gothia.
February 1433: Theodoro backs a Greek rising at Cembalo.
February 1433: Cembalo (Balaklava) passes to the Greek rebels backed by Theodoro.
June 1434: Cembalo is lost to Genoa.
End of December 1475: Mangup surrenders to the Ottomans.
December 1475: the principality ceases to exist.

wars.name: Tamerlane's raid on Gothia
wars.outcome: Tamerlane destroyed several towns including Gothia's capital Theodoro; no land changed hands on the page.

wars.name: Theodoro-Genoese conflicts over Gothia
wars.outcome: 1423: Alexios attacks and the Genoese pay a large sum to repel him; February 1433 Theodoro backs a rising at Cembalo; June 1434 Genoa retakes Cembalo and plunders Kalamita, which Theodoro reclaims; Cembalo revolts again in 1439.

wars.name: Ottoman conquest of Crimea (Gedik Ahmed Pasha's expedition)
wars.outcome: The Ottoman fleet leaves Constantinople on 20 May 1475, takes Caffa by 6 June, besieges Theodoro castle from September; Mangup surrenders at the end of December 1475 and the principality ends.

certainty.note: Crimean mountain principality: the page names places (Mangup, Inkerman, Kalamita, Cembalo, Rybache) but no boundary or treaty line; the coastal strip of 1423-1475 is a reading.
